label: Cause of being: originating versus sustaining, time-indexed
resolution: CAUSE_OF_BEING_1 (OriginatesBeing) gives a thing being at a first moment of its presence and may then cease; CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 (SustainsBeing) gives it being at every moment at which it is present. Both are defined from the primitive BeingGiving.GivesAt over a TemporalHistory and differ in the moments at which giving is required. They overlap (a sustaining cause of a thing with a first moment of presence is also originating, originatesOfSustains) and are not exhaustive (preventing corruption, counterfactual dependence and the tenseless CausesIn are other relations). They are time-indexed refinements of the tenseless CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3 (CausesIn c x esse, disambiguation c3c01e92), which leaves the choice open; passage from CausesIn to either sense is an explicit open bridge. To make that passage visible to the sense rules, both senses are also listed in c3c01e92 as CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_4 (originating) and CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_5 (sustaining), with the same definitions and declarations; the bridges CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3 -> CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_5 are the sustaining reading 23e04ae5 and its restriction to causes of another's being ce55210c (derived from the concurrence premise d7f5a528 or from 23e04ae5), declared in sense_bridges of every argument that uses them (ffef89fd, 0681f64a, 366a6ea3, 835330d4, 2c3e7898, 150d634d). Those arguments declare CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_5 in term_senses, not CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3: the declaration of sense 3 is CausesAllInGenus, which their theorems, stated over an abstract CausesIn, do not mention. CausingBeingIsOriginating appears only in the controls. This record keeps the finer originating/sustaining split for arguments that choose between the two. The primitive GivesAt has two readings (definition 158301bc): strict esse-giving, under which both senses are causes of being (CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_3 time-indexed), and inclusive, which also counts causing coming to be (CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_1, CausesOrigin). CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 is meant strictly. CAUSE_OF_BEING_1 is stated for both; on the inclusive reading it is a time-indexed cause of coming to be acting at the first moment (the builder of q.104 a.1 co., who causes the house's becoming, not its being), and no formal bridge relates it to CausesOrigin. Neither sense is the sourced direct per se conservation of esse (definition 56989bd0, q.104 a.1): CAUSE_OF_BEING_2 is its time-indexed image without the dependence clause. Uses: the presence step of the immensity sense bridge (8bf775e9) needs CAUSE_OF_BEING_2; the originating reading fails it (SustainingCausation Control part 1, existential inertia). The lasting-ground premise A2ab (71df1177) has a route through each sense: the sustaining route needs no condition on time; the originating route, on this formulation (an originating cause at the first moment of presence overall), needs comparability of moments (linear time, an explicit premise) and no return after absence (Control part 6); an originating premise tied to the first moment after the absence would need neither, only contact and originators-as-grounds (not formalized here). No argument passes between the senses without one of these named statements.
